verdict.rationale: No downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent formal spec is evidenced: a probe of the standard spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 on every one. The llms.txt index, the markdown LLM API reference and the `cdp mcp` server, which exposes endpoints as tools, are adjacent machine-friendly features, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit. The spec could still exist at a non-standard path, hence medium confidence.
